QUOTE: "Its init function, `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`), zeroes a static heap, then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own functions."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself via the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user. It even says "the library uses the same hook" without stating exclusivity.
